using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    const int MOD = 998244353;

    auto get_factors = [](long long n) {
        std::set<long long> factors;
        for (long long i = 1; i * i <= n; ++i) {
            if (n % i == 0) {
                factors.insert(i);
                factors.insert(n / i);
            }
        }
        return vector<long long>(factors.begin(), factors.end());
    };

    auto modular_inverse = [&](long long n) {
        long long res = 1, power = MOD - 2, base = n;
        while (power > 0) {
            if (power & 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            power >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    };

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    int rock1, sci1, paper1;
    cin >> rock1 >> sci1 >> paper1;
    int rock2, sci2, paper2;
    cin >> rock2 >> sci2 >> paper2;

    auto max_score = [&]() {
        return min(rock1, sci2) + min(sci1, paper2) + min(paper1, rock2);
    };

    auto match_result = [](int a, int b) {
        if (a == b) return 0;
        if ((a == 1 && b == 2) || (a == 2 && b == 3) || (a == 3 && b == 1))
            return 1;
        else
            return -1;
    };

    auto calculate = [&](vector<vector<int>> l1, vector<vector<int>> l2) {
        int total = 0;
        int c1 = 0, c2 = 0;
        while (!l1.empty() || !l2.empty()) {
            try {
                if (c1 == 0) {
                    auto temp = l1.back(); l1.pop_back();
                    c1 = temp[0];
                }

                    c2 = temp[0];
                }

                return total;
            }
            int min_val = min(c1, c2);
            int match_res = match_result(l1.empty() ? 0 : l1.back()[1], l2.empty() ? 0 : l2.back()[1]);
            total += max(0, min_val * match_res);
            if (c1 < c2) {
                c2 -= c1;
                c1 = 0;
            } else if (c1 > c2) {
                c1 -= c2;
                c2 = 0;
            } else {
                c1 = c2 = 0;
            }
        }
        return total;
    };

    auto min_score = [&]() {
        vector<vector<int>> perm1, perm2;
        vector<vector<int>> base1 = {{rock1, 1}, {sci1, 2}, {paper1, 3}};
        vector<vector<int>> base2 = {{rock2, 1}, {sci2, 2}, {paper2, 3}};
        int min_ans = INT_MAX;

        std::vector<int> indices = {0, 1, 2};
        do {
            perm1.clear();
            for (int i : indices) {
                perm1.push_back(base1[i]);
            }
            do {
                perm2.clear();
                for (int j : indices) {
                    perm2.push_back(base2[j]);
                }
                auto perm1_copy = perm1;
                auto perm2_copy = perm2;
                min_ans = min(min_ans, calculate(perm1_copy, perm2_copy));
            } while (next_permutation(indices.begin(), indices.end()));
        } while (next_permutation(indices.begin(), indices.end()));

        return min_ans;
    };

    cout << min_score() << " " << max_score() << "\n";

    return 0;
}
